items.item_text: Required to hold a valid California driver's license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program
Experience in floor care equipment, materials, procedures and best practices.

This position includes but is not limited to performing semi-skilled and skilled cleaning, housekeeping and/or general maintenance duties in all areas on the UCDH campus; waste handling for regular, regulated medical waste (rmw) and linen waste and perform other duties as assigned. Ensures all necessary procedures for equipment are used in accordance with departmental safety policies. This position is physically demanding and will require a great deal of lifting, stretching, walking and bending.
Skills to organize and prioritize workload to complete work effectively.
Skills to work collaboratively and independently within a diverse team and fast paced environment
Verbal and written communication skills to read, write and follow oral and written instructions in English.
Knowledge of floor care equipment, materials, procedures and best practices.
Skills to use computers, navigate email and other necessary UC programs.
Knowledge of and skills to operate power machines such as floorcare equipment and trash compactor.
Knowledge of and skills to operate UCDH vehicles.
Skills to use mobile devices, voceras and other communication devices.
